title: Social provider config
description: Per-agency credentials for the social analytics pipeline. Each agency brings its own Meta and TikTok app — your tokens never leave your tenant. The app secret is sealed with the same key we use for OAuth tokens, then re-fetched only when the cron or a Re-test needs it.
forbiddenBody: Only agency admins can configure provider credentials.
providersBody: Save a row to enable the provider for every workspace in this agency. The first save takes about a minute; you can rotate the secret any time by re-pasting — the existing OAuth connections keep working until you remove the row.
callbackPasteMeta: Paste this URL into the "Valid OAuth Redirect URIs" field in your Meta app. Each agency has their own URL — the state token keeps every flow isolated.
callbackPasteTiktok: Paste this URL into the "Redirect URL" field in your TikTok app. Each agency has their own URL — the state token keeps every flow isolated.
appSecretRequiredError: App id and app secret are required.
enabledHelp: Disable to stop new OAuth flows without losing the secret.
removeConfirmSuffix: provider config? Existing OAuth connections keep working until each workspace disconnects them.
metaStep1: Sign in to {url} with this agency's developer account.
metaStep2: click the agency's app (the App ID shown on this card).
metaStep3: Left sidebar → Facebook Login for Business → Configurations.
metaStep4: Open the config whose ID matches the agency's "Login for Business config id" (shown above). If no config exists, create one first.
metaStep5: Scroll to Valid OAuth Redirect URIs → paste the URL above → Save Changes.
tiktokStep1: Sign in to {url} with this agency's developer account.
tiktokStep4: Add the URL above to Redirect URIs → Save.
metaAlsoRequiredBody: Settings → Basic — toggle ON Client OAuth Login and Web OAuth Login, and add {domain} to App Domains. Without App Domains, Meta rejects the redirect even with the URI allowlisted.
perAgencyNote: Each agency does this once for their own app. The URL is unique per agency because each agency owns their own Meta/TikTok app — a global callback would mix tenants and force every agency to share one app, which neither provider allows.
publishingReadinessBody: Publishing is a separate capability from analytics and stays disabled until the provider, agency, and workspace gates are approved.
publishingStatusHint: Enable this only after Meta approval and sandbox validation. Live provider mutation is not available in this release.
analyticsProbeBody: Select a connected profile to verify Meta scopes and current metric access without changing stored analytics data.
analyticsProbeEmpty: No connected Meta profiles are available.
analyticsProbeFailed: The analytics probe could not be completed.
analyticsProbeTooltipAvailable: Metric is supported and Meta returned a value for the current window.
analyticsProbeTooltipUnsupportedFacebook: Facebook Pages do not expose an accounts_engaged metric in the Graph API. Use the daily engaged users number in Page Insights UI instead. See ADR 0005.
analyticsProbeTooltipUnsupportedGeneric: This platform does not expose this metric. The capability registry in src/lib/social/metrics.ts is the source of truth; see ADR 0005.
analyticsProbeTooltipNoData: Metric is supported but Meta returned an empty window — usually a new account or a period with no activity. Re-test in 24-48h.
analyticsProbeTooltipErrorMetricUnavaila: Meta returned error code 100 for this metric — usually app mode (In Development), missing Standard Access on App Review, or a Page access token missing a task. Triage: docs/operations/meta-devtools-mcp.md.
analyticsProbeTooltipErrorPermissionDeni: The connector's access token is missing a required scope. Reconnect the channel from /app/agency-settings/social to refresh the token.
analyticsProbeTooltipErrorAuthExpired: The connector's access token has expired or been revoked. Reconnect the channel.
analyticsProbeTooltipErrorRateLimited: Meta throttled the request. The probe will retry on the next tick — usually < 1h.
analyticsProbeTooltipErrorGeneric: Meta returned an error. See the error code above and the MCP triage doc.
